name: Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm
nameVi: Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm – Hội An
summary: Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm is the swiftlet nest registered as a geographic indication on 23 November 2020. The Đà Nẵng city portal on 28 May 2026 quotes the grades yến quang, yến thiên, and yến bài from nearly 100 million to nearly 180 million VND a kilogram. That is a product range, not a bowl price. A serving price is Check on arrival.
origin: Cham Islands. Nests from Hòn Lao, Hòn Tai, and Hòn Khô, in the trade of Tân Hiệp.
culture: The 28 May 2026 city portal says the geographic indication Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm – Hội An was registered on 23 November 2020. Harvests then ran from mid-April to early May and from mid-August to early September, about four or five days each. The visitor sight it points to is the nest-trade temple in Bai Huong, not the cliff.
howToEat: Steamed, if you are buying the product. The city portal does not describe a cup, a texture, or a shop hour.
The kilogram range is not a snack price. A serving price is Check on arrival.
where: The trade of Tân Hiệp. The 28 May 2026 city portal names no shop.
seoTitle: Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm — registered swiftlet nests
seoDescription: Swiftlet nests from Tân Hiệp, registered 23 November 2020. A 2026 kilogram range is not a bowl price. A serving price is Check on arrival.
